Hollywood Fame - Hidden Object Adventure.name: Hollywood Fame: Hidden Object Adventure
Hollywood Fame - Hidden Object Adventure.summary: Your dream finally comes true: becoming a major Hollywood star! Unfortunately, not everything goes according to plan... Play as Jess Mallory, a young woman seemingly blessed by luck, who needs you and your powers of observation to make a place for herself under the Hollywood sun. Dive into the world of stars and overcome the challenges you face: lots of hidden object games, mini-games and achievements to win.
